info.name: List available rewards for a customer

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The ID of the customer in your platform or e-commerce store.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter rewards by a specific site in multi-site programs.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter rewards by location.

items.docs: Lists the rewards a given customer can currently claim, optionally filtered by site and country.

params.name: reward_id
params.description: The ID of the reward in the program catalog.

items.docs: Enables a reward in the program catalog so shoppers can claim it. Verb and path modeled from the documented resource index; verify against the live reference.

params.name: reward_id
params.description: The ID of the reward in the program catalog.

items.docs: Disables a reward in the program catalog so shoppers can no longer claim it. Verb and path modeled from the documented resource index; verify against the live reference.
